_doc: Min-max T1-T5 hull upgrade policy locked to exact division specialty splits and built-in hull passives (inherent_capabilities). Cross-empire bargains allowed within each specialty's strict min-max ladder; zero prestige-locked hulls, zero stationary mobile bases, zero unshielded 0-slot barges, zero T5 cargo/berth downgrades. Birth-empire affinity fills optimal specialty seats while preserving exact division percentage splits. T5 hulls also require Empire Reputation 60 + Piloting 50; max_auto_tier gates live auto-spend.
